name: io.github.rahuldinho17/perdollar
description: Decide which LLM to run a task on. Returns the cheapest model capable enough from the models you can reach, with data residency applied before cost, plus a ledger of what each decision saved against the model you would have used anyway. Prices are verified against provider pages daily.

environmentVariables.name: PERDOLLAR_FEED
environmentVariables.description: Override the price feed URL. Defaults to the public feed at per-dollar.vercel.app.

environmentVariables.name: PERDOLLAR_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where the local savings ledger is written. Defaults to ~/.perdollar. Nothing is sent anywhere.
